svg.title: Deadline Dash
svg.desc: Case file for Deadline Dash: never miss a CLA again. A chart with one pin per commit: 1,518 commits by the hourly sync bot above the line, 362 by Tahcin below it. The bot started syncing on 10 May 2026. Handwritten: I made 362 commits. Then I made the thing that has made 1,518 more.
